pr_title: Fix NRE in EmitCall for DynamicMethod
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/67084

Added an internal `SignatureHelper.AddDynamicArgument` to pass `DynamicScope` to get tokens for custom modifiers.
It expects the type to be a `RuntimeType`

issue_context.title: NullReferenceException in System.Reflection.Emit.SignatureHelper.AddOneArgTypeHelper when using ILGenerator.EmitCall on an interface method with 'in' arguments.
comments:
The signatureHelper uses `m_module` to get the tokens for the modifier and in many other places. This means DynamicMethod can't make use of it.

I noticed for ` Emit(OpCode opcode, MethodInfo meth!!)`, It just uses a count based on a list. I assume the correct fix is to use the same mechanism?
I do not think it can be as simple as that. It still needs to store the optional argument types.
@ruediger-stevens thanks for the nice repro. I verified this worked in .NET 5.0 (Core) but doesn't in 6.0\7.0.

review_comments:
`parameterTypes == null` is treated as an empty array later, and we will ignore the `requiredCustomModifiers` in that case.

Should this condition be more like `if ((requiredCustomModifiers != null) && parameterTypes?.Length ?? 0 != requiredCustomModifiers.Length)` ?

I see that you have copied this over from the non-Dynamic case, so it may be a bug in that code too.
The check disallow cases where `requiredCustomModifiers` is not null but `parameterTypes `is null. It throws if that is the case
